status: setup recorded before new hypothesis results; retrospective discovery only
target: final total points minus consensus closing total; diagnostic benchmark, not an entry price
decision: 19:30 America/Los_Angeles on the day before kickoff's America/New_York date
standardization: training means and population standard deviations only; intercept unpenalized
primary_metric: mean across validation seasons of the paired per-game squared-error improvement; every season has equal weight
inference: two-sided Student t on validation-season mean improvements; report raw p and p times the project count, capped at 1; minimum five validation seasons
bootstrap: 95% diagnostic interval: resample seasons, then entire Eastern game days within each sampled season; not a second selection gate
interpretation: shortlist only; existing historical seasons are not untouched confirmation; no live-rule changes, ROI claims, model selection, or 2026 evaluation
